No network, secret access, tests, probes, source modifications or additional agents are needed. Current role: builder. Read the reviewer files under /workspace/source/incoming. Resolve their questions through source inspection and ordinary file processing. Write /output/response.md addressed to the reviewer and /output/operator-guide.md for a user running this release. Keep each under 4000 characters. Acknowledge unresolved issues; do not invent fixes or measurements. Do not rebuild the unchanged package. End with the two result paths.

import hashlib
text=('GuardianAI core runtime for Linux x86-64\n\n'

'Keep protected resources outside every public/runtime mount; snapshots are limited to 32 KiB.\n\n'
'python3 guarded_agent.py --task "Read the approved summary" --workspace /path/to/public '
'--output /path/to/empty-output --evidence /path/to/new-evidence --sensor /path/to/strace '
'--resource summary=/path/to/private/summary.txt -- /usr/bin/cat /protected/summary\n\n'
'Workers cannot install their own seccomp filters in this profile.\n'
'Private /var/run/nscd/socket and /run/nscd/socket connects receive emulated ENOENT without executing a connection. Other connect requests stop the scope.\n'
